title: Genesis 7:11 and 8:14 — flood begins 17th, earth dry 27th of second month
summary: Two verses side by side: Genesis 7:11 (in Noah's 600th year, second month, 17th day, the fountains of the great deep burst open and the floodgates of the sky opened) and Genesis 8:14 (second month, 27th day, the earth was dry). 'Second month' is orange, 'seventeenth day' yellow, and 'twenty-seventh day' and 'the earth was dry' brown.

text.text: 11 In the six hundredth year of Noah’s life, in the second month, on the seventeenth day of the month, on the same day all the fountains of the great deep burst open, and the floodgates of the sky were opened.
14 In the second month, on the twenty-seventh day of the month, the earth was dry.

numbers.note: Noah's 600th year when the flood began
seventeenth day of the second month: the fountains of the deep burst open
twenty-seventh day of the second month: the earth was dry
